name: Tumblr Soft Grunge
summary: A pale, moody photo look from reblog blogs: faded pastel on a dark ground, film grain, light leaks, torn paper edges and small typewriter captions. It is sad and soft, not loud.

philosophy.core_thesis: A feed of reblogged scraps that feels like a teenager's wall: faded, tender and a little broken.
design_principles: Set the ground at a dark mauve-grey (#2A2528) and let photos fade to pastel pink (#E6A5B8) and sage (#9FB8A8).
Lift the blacks to 15% grey, lower the saturation to 60% and add a grain of 8% to 12%.
Add a light leak: a warm orange or pink gradient across 20% to 30% of one photo edge at 40% opacity.
Crop photos to 500px to 540px wide and stack them in one column of the dashboard with 20px gaps.
Tilt overlaid stickers and tape by 2° to 5° and tear the paper edge at 6px to 10px.
Set captions in a typewriter face at 13px in lower case with a pale grey (#C7B8BE) colour.
Overlay a thin quote in a script or a typewriter face over the photo at 70% opacity.
anti_patterns: Tidy aligned rows with no overlap

layout.grid_mechanics: A single dashboard column of 500px posts with 20px gaps; sticker and tape layers sit over the photo corners.
layout.whitespace_ratio: 20% to 30% stays empty; the spacing scale is 4, 10, 20 and 40px.
layout.alignment_rules: Photos centre in the column; captions sit flush left; stickers tilt off the grid by 2° to 5°.
layout.container_geometry: Photos with a 0px to 2px radius and torn paper edges; tape strips of 60px by 20px at 60% opacity.

font_pairings.note: A worn typewriter face for captions, with a clean mono body.
A thin hand-drawn capital face for a quote on the photo.
A fine italic serif for a soft, literary quote.

hierarchy_rules: Set quotes in italic at 70% opacity.

color.palette_structure: A dark plum-grey ground with washed pink, sage and lilac, and one bleached white.
color.contrast_rules: Text on the plum ground holds at least 10:1; pastel colours carry photo tints, tape and accents.
color.surface_treatment: A flat dark ground with a grain overlay of 6% to 10%; photos carry the faded colour; torn paper layers at 90% opacity.
color.light_and_shadow: Soft light leaks at 40% opacity on photo edges; no hard shadow; a 1px dark edge under tape.

materiality.surface_simulation: A bedroom wall of printed photos, tape and torn paper.
materiality.border_rules: A 1px #6B5C63 line on posts; torn edges of 6px to 10px on paper layers.
materiality.blur_and_elevation: A 2px blur on far stickers; a 6px soft shadow at 25% opacity under tape.

ornamentation_details.iconography: Thin outline icons at 20px with a 1.5px stroke, in a hand-drawn style: heart, star and moon.
ornamentation_details.illustration: Doodled stars, hearts and crescent moons in white line at 60% opacity; scanned film edges.

motion.transition_physics: Reblogs drop into the dashboard with a 300ms fade and a 12px rise; stickers do not move; a slow 20s drift shifts the light leak by 40px.
motion.hover_and_active: Hover raises the photo by 2px and the tape tilt changes by 1°; the like heart fills pink in 200ms.

emotion.target_response: The viewer feels a gentle, lonely melancholy and a wish to belong.

avoid_when: The product needs a bright, trustworthy, corporate tone.
The text is long and must be easy to read.
The audience is a young child.

modifiers.how: Remove tape, stickers and torn edges; keep the fade and set a quiet matte grade.
Switch to a cream ground, add the white print border and warm the fade to amber.
Add heavy collage, bold type and a hard photocopy texture.

pack.why: A hand-drawn line family that matches doodled stars and hearts on a dark wall.

ground.why: The ground is a photocopied scrap wall: grain and uneven ink behind the photos.
